_comment: Board tokens swept BEFORE the capped general sweep, never truncated, and EXEMPT from the big-company and aggregator filters (that is the point of naming them). NEVER exempt from the personal blocklist (data/personal-exclude.json). Keyed by persona, or `_all` for every persona; only ATSs with an open discovery API belong here (greenhouse, lever, ashby, workable, smartrecruiters). Example: "primary": { "greenhouse": ["acme"], "lever": ["examplecorp"] }
